'''October 2001 Sydney tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sydney, Australia on 14 October 2001. [[Clarrie Brown]] won it. It is known from Ben May's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3055">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectivd3055/ sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectiv], DeckTech (Ben "Hobbie65" May, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-sydney-14-10-01-from-another-perspectivd3055/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clarrie Brown]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* This report's byline is Jason Baretta, who finished 2nd; Ben May's report of the same event lists Jared Brown 2nd and says Jared posted a report of the day.<ref name="tr-d3054" />
